_about: Traced line art for the car drawings (cuore/web/sensor_profile_svg.py). The ink paths are a potrace-style fill trace of the source drawing (every contour of the ink, fill-rule evenodd), mapped into CUORE's frames by pinning the wheel centres to the axles; nothing was redrawn. Tools: docs/research/car-art-refs/stelvio-949/tools/trace.py. Top and rear views are constructed orthographically (see each view's 'method'): the top from the side and front traces plus the official dimensions, the rear from the front envelope with heights from the side view; both are stroked line art, not traces.

source.title: 2017 Alfa Romeo Stelvio blueprint
source.author: getoutlines.com
source.attribution: 2017 Alfa Romeo Stelvio blueprint by getoutlines.com, CC BY 4.0
source.accuracy_note: vendor states 95 to 99 percent; checked against cuore/data/vehicle_dimensions.json (see fit)

side.note: nose and tail within 1 unit of the official overhangs (861 / 1008 mm); tyre radius 58.8 units vs 59

front.note: width pinned to 1903 mm; the drawing's height comes out 259 units vs 267 official (about 3 percent short), left as drawn

top.method: constructed orthographically: x positions from the side-view trace (nose 61, headlamps 73-143, A-pillar base 276, windscreen top 470, B-pillar 485, rear glass start 632, spoiler edge 720, tail 811), widths from the front-view trace (body 1903 mm, mirrors 2082 mm, roof 917 mm at rail level, windscreen 1073/1475 mm) and the official tracks 1613/1653 mm

rear.method: constructed orthographically: silhouette = the front-view trace's envelope mirrored (the outer envelope is the same from both ends); feature heights from the side-view trace (spoiler edge y=77, glass bottom 126, lamps 130-172, bumper top 232, diffuser 258-288); widths from the CC BY-SA rear reference photo (docs/research/car-art-refs/stelvio-949/)
